{{Quote|Every soldier knows that war is more than arms and armor, every warrior carries an image of impending victory in his heart. When the image shatters, to be replaced by defeat, he is beaten. But sometimes a warrior receives assistance from an unexpected source, an in-rush of light, blasting away his fear and despair, releasing new inner strength! Yes, a war is much more than arms and armor. Half of every conflict is the will to win. We are Jedi. We must recognize that the will to win, and the power of war, are given sometimes by the dark side. And sometimes, as dawn throws back the night, victory is given&hellip;by the light!|Arca Jeth, while implementing Jedi battle meditation|audio=ArcaJethMonologue-TOTJ.flac|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi (audio)">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
'''Battle meditation''' or '''Enhanced Coordination''' was a [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|ability]] that considerably boosted the morale, stamina, and overall battle prowess of an individual's allies while simultaneously reducing the opposition's combat-effectiveness by eroding their will to fight.

==Description==
Battle meditation was the ability to use the Force to coordinate allies and even entire [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] of [[Starship/Legends|ships]], allowing them to perform at maximum efficiency, acting as a single entity with the ability to counter every enemy move quickly and effectively. Though ideal for meditating large-scale conflicts, battle meditation was also effective when employed for the benefit of one's comrades in small skirmishes, attacks, and duels. It could also be used to simultaneously demoralize the opponents, reducing their combat effectiveness. Battle meditation was used to influence armies and fleets to win battles and even wars.<ref name="JVS" />

==Applications==
===Light side users===
{{Quote|With sufficient concentration, a Jedi&mdash;such as you or I&mdash;can strengthen the hopes of our allies and heighten the fears of our enemies&hellip;thus, what the armies know in their hearts ''must'' become true&hellip; because they believe it so strongly.|Odan Urr|<ref name="Gold Age 0">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 0|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 0]]</ref>}}
[[File:OdanBattleMed.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Kirrek pirates lose their will to fight under the influence of Odan-Urr's battle meditation.]]
This [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] was first made famous by the ancient [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Odan-Urr/Legends|Odan-Urr]], [[Arca Jeth]], and [[Nomi Sunrider]]. Odan-Urr used it during the [[Unification Wars (Koros)/Legends|Unification Wars]],<ref name="GAOTS">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith]]''</ref> while Arca Jeth used it with great success during the [[Beast Wars]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].<ref name="BWOO">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Ulic Qel-Droma and the Beast Wars of Onderon]]''</ref> Being naturally adept, Nomi Sunrider applied battle meditation in nearly every conflict she participated in, such as the [[Freedon Nadd Uprising]],<ref name="FNU">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising]]''</ref> and the [[Battle of Koros Major (Great Hyperspace War)|Battle of Koros Major]].<ref name="DLOTS2">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 2|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 2]]</ref> It was also practiced by [[Bastila Shan]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]] and the [[Battle of Rakata Prime]], with impressive results.<ref name="TOTJ">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

During the [[New Sith Wars]], the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] Jedi Master [[Worror Dowmat]] used battle meditation to bolster the strength of [[Jedi Lord]] [[Valenthyne Farfalla]] and the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]], as they fought against [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Skere Kaan|Kaan's]] [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]]. Dowmat also assisted his Jedi companions with his Battle meditation when they [[Duel on Tython|confronted]] [[Darth/Legends|Darths]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Bane]] and [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Zannah]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], [[90 BBY/Legends|ten years]] after the war's end. Dowmat's meditation provided the invigoration necessary for [[Johun Othone]], [[Sarro Xaj]], [[Echani/Legends|Echani]] Jedi [[Raskta Lsu]], and Farfalla to contend with Darth Bane, who was himself being fueled by his dark side rage.<ref name="ROT">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref>

[[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] was also quite skilled, having used battle meditation during his [[Mission to Vjun (Clone Wars)|Mission to Vjun]] to empower the actor pretending to be him. With a mere touch, Yoda was able to saturate [[Palleus Chuff]] with feelings of hope and mission success, while simultaneously eliminating feelings of doubt and despair from the little man's spirit.<ref name="YDR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref> Yoda also successfully meditated the conflict during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]].<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> Both [[Yarael Poof/Legends|Yarael Poof]] and [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]] used it in the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]] and the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] respectively.<ref name="SOS">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Siege of Saleucami]]''</ref> During the Clone Wars, [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] was able to encourage and calm troopers during the conflicts she took part in, suggesting that she had the potential to use Battle Meditation or some lesser form of this ability.

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] studied the use of battle meditation at some point after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] from a [[Unidentified Jedi book|book]] he found.<ref name="DEA">[[Dark Empire II (audio drama)|''Dark Empire II'' audio drama]]</ref> His sister [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] also studied battle meditation from books recovered on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], and employed her new ability against the reborn [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].<ref name="EEA">[[Empire's End (audio drama)|''Empire's End'' audio drama]]</ref> Due to this power's use by C'Baoth, however, Luke Skywalker did not hold the power in high regard until somewhat late in the Yuuzhan Vong War, even though he understood it was not automatically a dark side power.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream]]''</ref>

Jedi Masters [[T'ra Saa/Legends|T'ra Saa]] and [[K'Kruhk]] each utilized battle meditation during the final battles of the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], including the Jedi's [[Attack on the Hidden Temple|loss]] at [[Taivas]]<ref name="LW4">[[Legacy — War 4|''Legacy — War'' 4]]</ref> and its [[Battle of Coruscant (Second Imperial Civil War)|victory]] at [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="LW5">[[Legacy — War 5|''Legacy — War'' 5]]</ref> respectively.

A focused version of battle meditation was known as [[Force-meld|Force meld]]. Unlike battle meditation, which could influence both the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] and non-Force-sensitives of both sides, Force meld concentrated on coordinating and improving the Force-sensitives of the user's side.<ref name="JVS" />

===Dark side users===
{{Quote|In the old days, the Dark Lords of the Sith built meditation chambers in their warships. In the heat of battle, they would seal themselves in the chambers&hellip;and direct powerful visualizations upon the conflict that raged all around them.|Odan Urr|<ref name="EOTW" />}}
[[File:BattleMeditation.png|thumb|right|250px|Bastila Shan supporting the Sith fleet in 3,956 BBY during the Battle of Rakata Prime.]]
Battle meditation was not merely a province of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]]; powerful [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] users could twist the wills of their commanded armies not through subtle influence, but with total domination. This variant of battle meditation was called Sith Battle Coordination by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady]] [[Lumiya]]. It was later identified by Darth Caedus as "Sith Battle meditation".<ref name="Inferno" />

When [[Nomi Sunrider]] asked of her Master if those who use the dark side were able to command battle meditation, Odan-Urr replied that indeed they could, but it was very rare.<ref name="EOTW" /> Lord Skere Kaan also used Sith battle meditation during the [[New Sith Wars]] in opposition to the superior prowess of a [[Unidentified Cerean Jedi|female Cerean Jedi Master]].<ref name="POD">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref> [[4 ABY/Legends|One thousand years later]], [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Nial Declann]] was a master of Sith battle meditation, using it to great effect during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="ww">{{InsiderCite|66|Who's Who: Imperial Grand Admirals}}</ref> Following [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine's death, the shock of the sudden removal of the Sith's battle influence threw the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] into chaos and allowed the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel fleet]] to defeat them.<ref>[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi'' <small>(novelization)</small>]]</ref> [[Joruus C'baoth]], the insane [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] guardian of [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland's]] [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]], increased the victory percentage of Grand Admiral [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] ships by forty percent via dark battle meditation and at times commanded fleets from across star systems though at great strain.<ref name="HTTE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>  The clone seemed, to Pellaeon, to perhaps be able to command ships full of clones more easily since the minds of those men were so similar.<ref name="The Last Command">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>

When [[Darth Caedus]] ascended to [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], he soon found out that within his mind he could coordinate and direct battle into whatever outcome he so desired. He would use a [[Meditation chamber/Legends|meditation chair]] on board his [[Anakin Solo (starship)|personal star destroyer]] to amplify his powers. Caedus' early uses of the art were poor, as his first attempts only resulted in him being able to ''see'' the battle unfolding in his mind, not being able to directly influence it.<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> When he tried to dominate the wills of his subordinates via the Force he found that they were not so easily subjugated, and reacted with hostility to his psychic intrusion. His powers were greatly augmented by [[Alema Rar]] as he attempted to [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Galactic Civil War)|lay siege]] to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], and what seemed like a battle lost became a victory for the Alliance.<ref name="Inferno" /> Caedus practiced regularly (he had plenty of opportunity since his early time as a Sith was heavily engrossed in war), and his proficiency became much stronger. Caedus would [[Flow-walking|Flow-walk]] into the immediate future to see the next battle, and then return to the present to directly influence the battle to bring about the ends he desired. He shortly thereafter gave up the use of his meditation chair upon its destruction by Luke Skywalker and meditated battle directly from the bridge of the ''Anakin Solo''.<ref name="Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref> During the [[Second Battle of Fondor]], Darth Caedus used battle meditation to dominate the collective wills of [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor's]] ground forces, causing them to doubt their chances of victory and drop the planet's defensive shielding.<ref name="Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The use and effect of battle meditation was first described in detail by [[Timothy Zahn]] in ''[[Heir to the Empire]]'', when [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] explains to [[Joruus C'baoth]] and [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] his own theory as to why the Battle of Endor was lost; he believed that Palpatine employed the power to an unwise degree, taking such close control of the Imperial forces as to make them puppets, almost incapable of fighting on their own when his influence was suddenly removed<ref name="HTTE" /> (the use of battle meditation at Endor was later also attributed to Grand Admiral [[Nial Declann]]).

In the 2003 [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic|''Knights of the Old Republic'']], the power is a plot element rather than an ability usable by any of the player-controled characters in gameplay. Because the character Bastila is one of the only living Jedi in the galaxy who has mastered the ability, she is a vital weapon to be used by either the Republic or the Sith.<ref name="TOTJ" />

In ''Knights of the Old Republic'', the power can only be used when the user is in deep concentration, and not in the midst of personal direct combat.<ref name="TOTJ" /> This was not the case for all users, as for example [[Nomi Sunrider]] is shown to use battle meditation while fighting.

In ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', battle meditation is a usable ability by any of the playable characters who are Force-sensitive. Using the power grants a bonus to attack rolls, damage, Will saves and increases Vitality Points Regeneration to the player's entire party. At higher levels, it can also impair enemies. If mastered, the power also has a story-based use, as it can be used by the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] in order to turn the tide of the [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] throne room battle to the favor of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Talia (Onderon)|Talia's]] or [[General/Legends|General]] [[Vaklu]]'s forces, depending on who the player has allied with.

In [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|''The Force Unleashed'' video game]], battle meditation was an upgradeable Force Talent. It decreased the amount of time it takes to charge Force powers.
